added.name: added units, Accessory dwelling units + Missing middle + Transit-oriented density 2027-2031, per tract
added.formula: P10, P50, P90 of 2,000 seeded draws, per tract, of each tract's added units authorized under Accessory dwelling units + Missing middle + Transit-oriented density (each run alone, minus the missing-middle units lost to lots ADUs use, plus the pro-forma interactions, tract by tract)

counties.formula: P10, P50, P90 of 2,000 seeded draws, per county, of the sum over the county's tracts of each tract's added units authorized under Accessory dwelling units + Missing middle + Transit-oriented density (each run alone, minus the missing-middle units lost to lots ADUs use, plus the pro-forma interactions, tract by tract)

total.name: combined added units of the tract-level reforms, Accessory dwelling units + Missing middle + Transit-oriented density 2027-2031, state
total.formula: P10, P50, P90 of 2,000 seeded draws of the sum over tracts of each tract's added units authorized under Accessory dwelling units + Missing middle + Transit-oriented density (each run alone, minus the missing-middle units lost to lots ADUs use, plus the pro-forma interactions, tract by tract) = 5,179 units, 10,124 units, 18,245 units

notes: The columns are the package's tract-level part, worked out tract by tract in every draw: overlap and interactions are inside them.
Parking requirement reduction and Development fee reduction work by county: their county values are in county_only and are not spread to tracts.
